Nodus could not complete this action. Check the HTTPS root, pairing code, server realm, connectivity and retained status. An unknown pairing request is retained for exact retry. No drafts were discarded.
Cancel this retained pairing request? Do this only if the web code is known to be invalid. If the network outcome was unknown, first check and revoke unexpected devices in Nodus web.
Remove the paired-device credential? This changes the credential epoch. Old pending and unknown operations remain retained for manual review and will not be replayed with a later credential.

Activate full synchronization with this server? All shared notes, lists, tags, notebooks, reminders and attachment bytes participate. Local-only notes remain private. Unsupported or inaccessible data remains blocked and is never silently discarded.
Stop subsequent synchronization requests? In-flight outcomes and all local drafts remain retained. Disconnecting does not delete server data.

Apply this retained proposal against a freshly read server revision? A concurrent server change may conflict again. The local draft is retained until authoritative projection is safe.
Discard this server proposal? This does not delete or acknowledge the local draft; it remains blocked for explicit review.
